resources.string: Nothing seeded. Every arm looks the same on a fully fogged map, so seed a walk before comparing.

Seeds a fixed synthetic walk — a curved corridor, a loop that crosses itself and a detached island — around your current location, or around a public park in Taipei if the device will not give one. The shape never changes, so switching arm is the only thing that differs between two looks. Points are marked as mock and can be cleared here.
